description: Create a new Security Case in OneUptime. Returns the created Security Case object with its ID. Use this to add new Security Cases to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

assignedToTeamId.description: ID of the team whose queue the case is in.

assignedToUserId.description: ID of the person working the case.

closingNote.description: Why the case was closed the way it was, in Markdown: what was found and what was done.

description.description: What is known about the threat, in Markdown. A case opened by a detection starts with the detection's description.

entities.description: The users, hosts, IP addresses, domains and files the case is about, each as { type, value }. Detections add theirs as they join the case.

labels.description: Labels to filter and report on cases by.

mitreTactics.description: ATT&CK tactic ids (TA0006) the case's detections are tagged with.

mitreTechniques.description: ATT&CK technique ids (T1110) the case's detections are tagged with.

priority.description: Critical, High, Medium, Low or Informational. A case opened by a detection starts at the detection's severity and rises when a more severe one joins it.

projectId.description: ID of the project this case belongs to.

status.description: New, Investigating, Contained or Closed. Every case starts New; closing it records a verdict.

title.description: What the case is about, in a line.
title.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

verdict.description: What the case turned out to be, set when it is closed: True Positive, Benign Positive, False Positive or Undetermined.

name: create_security_case
title: Create Security Case
